currentFormalFacts: The entire after-market scan aborts if no TDCC quality snapshot exists for marketDate.
If the global TDCC snapshot exists but a reached symbol has no numeric chipConcentration, scoreCandidate rejects with 缺集保持股集中度，不補假值.
TDCC validation accepts one weekly asOfDate not after scanDate and no more than 14 calendar days old.
TDCC validation requires at least 1500 complete symbol records globally, but does not require every same-day market row to exist in the TDCC stock map.
quality-status reports dataset existence/count/asOfDate; it does not report per-symbol coverage.
v7_quality_snapshots is same-key UPSERT mutable, and readQualitySnapshot returns only snapshot_json rather than updated_at/first-known lineage.

officialSourceSemantics.economicTimestampMeaning: TDCC states current data are compiled from each account's balance after the last business day of each week.

falsifiedAssumptions: A globally ready TDCC snapshot does not prove every Formal market symbol has chipConcentration.
chipAsOfDate<=scanDate does not prove the dataset was publicly available before the 18:10 decision cutoff on that historical scan date.
A missing chipConcentration reject is not an economic low-concentration signal; it is a missing-data rejection.
Legacy same-date quality snapshot presence is not immutable first-known PIT evidence because the row can be overwritten.
requiredProspectiveDenominator: semantic fingerprint and immutable parent generation
promotionGuard: No D1+ outcome comparison unless PIT availability before decision cutoff is proven.
No treating a missing symbol as concentration=0.
No using global count>=1500 as full per-symbol coverage.
No historical overwrite/backfill to manufacture first-known coverage.
No threshold or required/optional policy change from structural evidence alone.
